text:
mira (people-ops): heads-up: visitor Nina from Bloom coming at 11:20am with a toddler + stroller and a small cupcake box for the team. asked if we can chill a sealed jar (breastmilk) and stash the stroller. also wants a bright badge color so we can spot them. :baby: :cupcake:

eden (reception): got it. are we doing magenta or teal today? magenta stands out but we don't use it elsewhere.

jas (eng): magenta! i'll be in the lobby at 11:15 to help with stroller and cupcakes (no promises on not eating one). :laughing:

leo (facilities): stroller parking OK by the bike rack inside the north door. cupcake box to parcel shelf labeled `Bloom - Nina`. fridge top shelf reserved  please label jar with `Nina - Bloom - sealed`

frontdesk-bot: [AUTOREPLY] Visitor registered: Nina (Bloom). Badge queued for printing at 11:18. QR expires in 6 hours.

mira (people-ops): quick poll: react :heavy_heart_exclamation: for magenta, :large_blue_circle: for teal

(reactions): :heavy_heart_exclamation: x5, :large_blue_circle: x1

eden (reception): badge printed magenta, stroller parked, cupcakes on shelf (i hid one), jar labeled and in fridge, leaving sticky with wifi: Guest-Redwood-5500.

mira (people-ops): thank you! if anyone wants a mini cupcake, come by the lobby after the intro :cupcake:
